confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of San Juan prices for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because summer rates vary widely by season and neighbourhood. Puerto Rico uses USD, so no currency conversion applies to the anchors. FX: the 0.6947 figure for 2026-10-16 came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates table, not from opening the page directly. It may be provisional if published before the 4pm AEST fixing, so it should be checked against the final RBA value.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Estimated from the USD-denominated Caribbean and Latin American tourist market, with Old San Juan and Condado as the reference areas for prices.
